"''The Mayor's Majordomo, actually.|8D8 and the majordomo|audio=MajordomoActually.flac|}} '''Mok Shaiz's majordomo''' was a [[Twi'lek]] [[Gender|male]] who served the [[Ithorian]] [[Mok Shaiz]], [[mayor]] of [[Mos Espa]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. After the [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]] was [[Attack on Jabba's Palace (Boba Fett)|taken]] over by the [[bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett]], the [[majordomo]] visited the palace to greet [[Daimyo]] Fett and his accomplice, the [[assassin]] [[Fennec Shand]]. Fett and Shand had assumed that Shaiz himself had intended to visit to pay tribute, but sent the majordomo in his place, who then instead requested tribute from Fett. Fett declined to pay tribute, allowing the Majordomo to leave with his life, though the Twi'lek warned Fett to expect another delegation in the future as he departed. After assassins from the [[Order of the Night Wind]] [[Ambush outside of the Sanctuary|attacked]] Fett, one captured [[Unidentified Night Wind assassin|assassin]] claimed Shaiz had sent them. Fett and Shand went to the [[Mos Espa City Hall|city hall]] to confront the mayor. While the majordomo insisted his boss was busy, Fett and his party walked past the Twi'lek and before Shaiz. Fett and the Mayor exchanged in a light argument, with the Majordomo briefly trying to shut down Fett's accusations and delivering a payment of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] from Shaiz. Fett soon visited again to question Shaiz, the majordomo insisting that the mayor was again busy. After being threatened by Shand, the Twi'lek lied to the pair and left the room, locking the door behind him to try and flee. He rode away on a speeder, but Fett and Shand caught him leaving, and had their riders [[Chase through Mos Espa|chase]] him on speeders. The majordomo was pursued by through the streets of Mos Espa by the riders, crashing into many things in his rush. However, [[Drash|one]] rider caused him to crash, and he found himself confronted by Fett again, admitting to the Daimyo that Shaiz had in fact sided with the [[Pyke Syndicate]]. Under the custody of Fett and Shand, the majordomo made confessions, but his captors were unable to locate Shaiz. The Twi'lek was later present for a meeting between Fett and his assets. ==Biography== ===Early life=== {{Quote|I attended finishing academy. My parents were not wealthy by any means. I specialized in Civic Council Negotiations.|The majordomo on his early life|}} Earlier into his life, the Twi'lek was educated on the [[city]] [[planet]] [[Coruscant]], while he did not consider his parents to be wealthy considering the privileged position he was in. He attended finishing academy, and specialized in [[Civic Council Negotiations]]. ===Fett's arrival=== {{Quote|Actually, there is one other matter, if I may.''"
"''What is it?''"
"''The matter of tribute.|The majordomo and Boba Fett|audio=ActuallyTribute.flac|}} Around [[9 ABY]],{{BoBFDate}} the male Twi'lek worked as the [[majordomo]] to Mok Shaiz, the mayor of the city of Mos Espa and its surrounding plateaus on the [[desert]] planet Tatooine.{{Databank|tatooine|Tatooine}} After Jabba the [[Hutt]]'s [[Boba Fett's Palace|palace]] was [[Attack on Jabba's Palace (Boba Fett)|occupied]] by the bounty hunter Boba Fett{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 16: The Rescue}} in the same year,{{MandoDate|16}} Shaiz sent the majordomo to see Fett. [[File:MajordomoGreetings.png|thumb|left|300px|The majordomo, greeting Boba Fett and Fennec Shand]] Fett received the majordomo in the Palace's throne room, and was surprised to find that his guest was not the mayor himself, having expected Shaiz. Having been introduced by [[8D-series smelter droid]] [[8D8]] as being the mayor, the majordomo apologized for the confusion, explaining that the mayor was away on pressing matters. When Fett asked for tribute, the majordomo stated that he had brought none, except for Mayor Shaiz's heartfelt welcome to Mos Espa. [[Fennec Shand]], Fett's partner and [[Master Assassin|master assassin]], became annoyed and noted that the majordomo would have been fed to Jabba's pets for his insolence had the Hutt still been in power, though the majordomo was unphased by this. Fett told the majordomo to inform the mayor that he was here now, to which the majordomo responded that the mayor was aware. Though dismissed by Fett, the majordomo proceeded to request tribute from Fett, which confused the newly anointed [[crime lord]]. Fett allowed the majordomo to leave unharmed, despite being asked by Shand if he should be [[Death|killed]]. Shand conveyed the gift of his leave unmolested which the majordomo received with indifference, offering apologies and appreciation. As he exited the room, the majordomo told Fett that he should expect another delegation from the Mayor's office in the near future. ===Political unrest=== {{Quote|Pardon the lack of pomp for your entrance. However, I did not see your litter arrive. Nevertheless we are both honored and delighted by your serendipitous visit.|The majordomo greets Fett and his group|{{BOBF|Chapter 2: The Tribes of Tatooine}}}} Not long after, Fett was [[Ambush outside of the Sanctuary|attacked]] by six [[assassin]]s from the [[Order of the Night Wind]]. Shand was able to capture one [[Unidentified Night Wind assassin|Night Wind assassin]], who soon confessed that he had been sent by Mok Shaiz. As a result, Fett, Shand and their two [[Gamorrean Warrior|Gamorrean guards]] took the assassin to the [[Mos Espa City Hall|city hall]] of Mos Espa. Approaching the [[Unidentified clerk|city hall clerk]], Fett demanded to see the mayor, and the majordomo stepped in to greet the party, commenting that the Daimyo had not arrived with a litter. With no reply from Fett, the Twi'lek continued, calling the visit an honor but also informing them that Shaiz was busy. Regardless, Fett walked towards the door to the mayor's room. [[File:FettMayorMeeting-BOBFC2.png|thumb|right|300px|The majordomo failed to keep Boba Fett from disturbing Mok Shaiz]] The majordomo tried to stop Fett's group, insisting that the area was restricted, but the Daimyo walked through with his party regardless. With the visitors arriving before Shaiz, the majordomo apologized to the mayor for the intrusion. Shaiz asked who his visitors were, Fett insisting the mayor already knew that. Nevertheless, the majordomo introduced Fett to his superior, and the Daimyo accused the mayor of arranging his assassination. The Twi'lek tried to shut down Fett's claims until Shaiz identified the assassin's affiliation with the Order of the Night Wind, having Fett's captive shot. Because the Night Wind's were not allowed to operate outside of [[Hutt Space]], the mayor had his majordomo give a payment of [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to Fett for turning the assassin in. The Daimyo then exchanged snide remarks with the Twi'lek's boss before leaving the city hall. ===Fleeing Fett=== {{Quote|Actually, I may be able to rearrange some of the appointments that aren't as time sensitive as yours. Uh, so if you'll excuse me, I'll see what I'm able to do.|The majordomo, before fleeing the mayor's office|{{BOBF|Chapter 3: The Streets of Mos Espa}}}} [[File:MajordomoDriving.png|thumb|left|300px|The majordomo weaved through the streets of Mos Espa in an attempt to flee]] Meanwhile, Shaiz had promised the territories of Mos Espa to the [[Pyke Syndicate]], which was expanding its [[spice]] trade on Tatooine.{{BOBF|Chapter 4: The Gathering Storm}} The mayor left the town hall and flew off world—officially on a scheduled vacation—{{BOBF|Chapter 6: From the Desert Comes a Stranger}} before Fett returned to question him, having learned of Shaiz's new allegiance. The majordomo greeted Fett at the counter, insisting that the mayor had a very busy schedule. Shand advised him to choose his next words carefully, threatening his life. Swallowing, the majordomo claimed he could try and rearrange some of the mayors less time sensitive appointments, backing towards the office saying he needed a moment to see what he could do. Retreating to the mayors office under the guise of checking the schedule, he instead locked the door behind himself and fled to the [[Mok Shaiz's luxury speeder|mayor's luxury speeder]] to escape. Fett and Shand quickly caught on to the majordomo's escape attempt, exiting the city hall as the Twi'lek drove the [[Landspeeder|speeder]] away. The Daimyo ordered his gang of [[mods]] to [[Chase through Mos Espa|pursue]] the majordomo on their [[Mod scooter|custom]] [[Grav scoot|scooters]]. Fleeing through Mos Espa in a speeder, the majordomo weaved through the busy streets at high speeds, crashing into numerous objects while he drove, including a large water tower. Pursuing the Twi'lek,the mods soon chose to split up, eventually managing to flank the majordomo's speeder from all sides. The mod [[Skad]] and one of his comrades tried to damage the speeder's engines, but the Twi'lek rammed each away from him, Skad's accomplice crashing as a result. When a pair of [[Bith]] riding a rickshaw pulled by a droid nearly drove into his path, the majordomo tried to wave them out of his path. The droid quickly sped out of the way, with it's rickshaw narrowly being hit and spun around by the majordomo. [[File:MajordomoCrash.png|thumb|right|300px|The majordomo crashed while attempting to flee]] One of the mods, [[Drash]], drove her speeder onto a roof top and then plummeted her vehicle down to the majordomo's speeder, colliding with its right engine. The Twi'lek lost control and crashed through a farmer's market, his speeder becoming buried in [[meiloorun fruit]]. He tried to drive off, but found the speeder would no longer work. Fett, flying by [[jetpack]] arrived before the majordomo, asking where Shaiz was. Giving in, the Twi'lek admitted that the mayor was working with the [[Pyke]] Syndicate. ===Captivity=== {{Quote|Mayor Mok Shaiz is on their payroll and has flown off world, which leads us to believe a storm is about to break.''"
"''It was a scheduled vacation, actually.|Shand and the majordomo|}} [[File:Majordomocaptive.png|thumb|left|300px|The majordomo was held captive by Boba Fett, following his attempted escape in Mos Espa]] The majordomo was held in custody with his wrists in shackles under Fett following his attempted escape in Mos Espa. Despite the majordomo's confessions, Fett's enforcers did not locate the mayor even when combing the streets of the city, determining that he had indeed fled off world. Fett gathered his assets for a meeting about the rising threat of the Pyke Syndicate as the crime syndicate gathered troops in Mos Espa. Shand summarized the Pyke's culmination of forces and mentioned Shaiz fleeing off world as a sign war was about to break out. The majordomo stepped forward with claims that the mayor was on a scheduled vacation, but quickly conceded and stepped back when the others did not give a response. One [[Unidentified Gamorrean guard 2|Gamorrean guard]] got in his face, causing him to flich backwards. The Twi'lek then stood in the back as the meeting continued, with Shand concluding that Fett's forces needed foot soldiers to aid them against the Pykes. ===Showdown=== ====Preparing==== {{Quote|I shall go as your emissary. I have no compunction whatsoever genuflecting or even groveling if needs be, which would save you from any potential bruising of ego, so to speak.|The majordomo, on serving as the negotiator between Fett and the Pyke forces|}} As the forces of Fett's gotra and the Pyke Syndicate approached open warfare, the majordomo was one of several individuals with Fett in the ruins of the Sanctuary, which had been [[Destruction of Garsa Fwip's Sanctuary|bombed]] by the Pykes. While Fett and his cadre debated where to make their stand, the majordomo stood in the background looking concerned. The Daimyo was then drawn into a brief standoff with the [[Duros]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane]], who was hired by the Pykes, outside of the Sanctuary's ruins. After Bane and his Pyke shooters left the scenes, the majordomo exited the ruins and praised Fett's actions as an impressive display of restraint while offering his own advice. Fett mockingly questioned the price of the Twi'lek, prompting the latter to apologize and state he should not have interjected. The exchange was interrupted when Fett's allies reported that the three families of Mos Espa had turned on them. When Shand concluded that they needed to take out the Pyke Syndicate's leadership on Tatooine, Fett asked the majordomo if the Pyke's headquarters on the world was still located in the [[Mos Eisley]] [[spaceport]]. The Twi'lek was initially reluctant to tell the Daimyo, but with Shand cocking her rifle, he revealed that the Pykes still operated out of the [[Desert Survey Office]] in Mos Eisley. Thus Shand left to deal with the Pyke Syndicate aligned leadership. ====Aggressive negotiations==== {{Quote|Salutations! Salutations! I am unarmed but for this tablet bearing the terms of surrender. I wish to present to whomever spokesperson is empowered to deliberate an acceptable outcome in the eyes of the Oba Diah high council.|The majordomo, to a group of Pykes|}} Pyke foot soldiers soon arrived outside the Sanctuary, leading Fett and Djarin to prepare to fight them. The majordomo then cut in and offered his services as a negotiator, citing his studies in Civic Council Negotiations while insisting that his family had not been wealthy. As the Twi'lek was confident in negotiating a sufficient outcome in Fett's escape, the Daimyo agreed and demanded the majordomo's tablet to write terms to the Pykes on. Fett wrote down his terms of what the Twi'lek thought was a surrender and sent him outside to the Pyke forces. The majordomo declared himself unarmed and offered to read the supposed terms of surrender to the Pykes. The [[Unidentified Pyke capo|lead Pyke]] demanded he read it, calling him a tail-head. The majordomo laughed off the insult and began complementing the [[Obsidian Cliffs]] of the Pyke [[homeworld]] [[Oba Diah]], but the Pyke again demanded for the terms to be read. The majordomo began reading Fett's offer but quickly realized that the Daimyo had made no concessions, attempting to change the subject. The lead Pyke again demanded the Twi'lek to read Fett's offer, and the majordomo continued, reading out a threat from Fett to the Pykes. Angered, the Pyke in charge began raising his blaster, and the Twi'lek added that the threat was Fett's words and not his own. Unbeknownst to the Twi'lek, the attempted negotiation was a distraction which allowed Fett and Djarin to ambush the Pyke forces. As the pair flew in using jetpacks, firing on the Pyke forces, the majordomo quickly retreated back towards the ruins of the Sanctuary, briefly pausing to survey the battlefield. He hid behind a pillar, watching as the pair engaged the enemy forces. During the battle, the majordomo was found by [[Peli Motto]], who called him 'pretty face' and offered him protection. They were later approached by a roaring [[Boba's rancor|rancor]] who attacked the city, causing them to scream back. However, the [[rancor]] was [[Taming beasts|tamed]] by [[Din Grogu|Grogu]]. The majordomo helped Djarin, who was attacked by the rancor, to stand up. The war ended with [[Fett gotra]] driving off the Pykes out of the city. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Apologies and appreciation. The mayor may take it differently, but I shall indeed convey your sentiment. I would not be surprised if you receive another delegation in the near future.|audio=ApologiesAndAppreciation.flac|The majordomo, after being permitted to leave unharmed|}} [[File:MajordomoGratitude.png|thumb|right|250px|The majordomo, asking for tribute from Boba Fett]] The majordomo was a male Twi'lek with [[Color|orange]] skin and brown [[eye]]s. He was a smooth talker and was confident enough to ask the bounty hunter Boba Fett for tribute even though he was a guest at the palace utilized by Fett. When greeting the new crime lord, the majordomo's bow seemed perfunctory, while his departing bow carried a courtly flourish.Per the audio description for "[[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land]]" available on [[Disney+]]. Upon Fett's first unannounced visit to the city hall, the majordomo had a less exaggerated tone towards him, bringing no response from the Daimyo when he greeted him with a grin, but trying to continue his negotiation efforts nonetheless. As Fett walked past him, the majordomo attempted to protest, becoming more panicked when the Daimyo did not listen. Once Fett had reached Mok Shaiz, the Twi'lek changed his tone to apologize to the mayor for the interruption, quickly defending the mayor from Fett's accusations. The next time Fett abruptly arrived to visit the mayor, the majordomo was caught off guard, quickly creating excuses why the mayor could not be seen and frequently stumbling on his words. The Twi'lek froze when Fennec Shand threatened his life, struggling to muster a lie in order for him to flee. During his chase by Fett's riders, the panicked majordomo rushed through his obstacles. He was agitated when the riders tried to damage the engines, and continued to be fearful of the chasers until he was unable to escape. Trapped by Fett and his riders, the majordomo pouted momentarily in defeat, before giving confessing. After his capture by Boba Fett, the majordomo remained steadfastly loyal to Mok Shaiz, verbally defending the major even as he himself remained in shackles. When challenged by a Gamorrean guard following his verbal defense of the mayor, he flinched backwards. ==Equipment== The Twi'lek wore green [[robe]]s with golden accents and had two [[ring]]s on his right [[Limb|hand]]. He sported a piece of fabric [[Clothing|headwear]] that wrapped around his [[lekku]]. ==Behind the scenes== The majordomo was first pictured in the official trailer for the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Book of Boba Fett]]'', which was published on [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] on [[November 1]], [[2021]].{{SWYouTube|rOJ1cw6mohw|The Book of Boba Fett | Official Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/official-trailer-the-book-of-boba-fett}} He then made his debut in the first episode of the series, "[[Chapter 1: Stranger in a Strange Land]]," which was directed by [[Robert Rodriguez]] and released on [[December 29]] of that year.{{DisneyPlusYouTube|t9Ca4ARSfqA|Next On Disney+ | December 2021}} The character was portrayed by [[David Pasquesi]]. ==Appearances==
